actual: Claude Code and other MCP clients can call mcp_github_issue_create directly. The tool can create a GitHub Issue and update BUG allocator or BUG JSON outside the unified aistock_issue_workflow registry worktree flow, leaving half-submitted BUG records, stale reservations, root allocator drift, or long-running tool calls without progress. The fix must make MCP issue creation delegate to or return the standard workflow path, refuse canonical root main writes before allocation/GitHub creation, preserve enough recovery information, and add regression tests for no root pollution.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
